_doc: 第 7 幕每格背景描述，Claude 看地圖手寫，2026-11-13

EP1-07-01.zh: 鏡頭站在森林邊上，背對森林，對著河。腳下是一大片平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，一直延伸到水邊。再過去是一條很寬、流得很慢的河，從畫面左邊橫到右邊。河對岸是一條平平的泥灘，泥灘後面是開闊、朦朧的森林，顏色很淡，樹和樹之間有空隙。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來，照亮河面和對岸。茂密的森林和那棵大樹都在鏡頭後面，畫面裡看不到。
EP1-07-01.en: Background: The camera stands at the edge of the forest with its back to the trees, facing the river. Right in front is a wide, flat stretch of bare mud that runs all the way to the water. Beyond it a wide, slow river crosses the picture from left to right. On the far bank is a strip of flat muddy riverside ground, and behind it a distant, open, hazy forest, soft and pale, with gaps between the trees. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right and lights up the water and the far bank. The dense forest and the huge tree are behind the camera and are not in the picture.
EP1-07-01.conflict: prompt 寫相機在近岸（on the near riverbank），地圖上相機 L21 是森林邊緣第一排；照地圖寫成站在森林邊上、背對森林。另外地圖的腳印 L19 就在鏡頭正前方很近的地方，但地圖規定腳印只在腳印那幾格出現（only_shots），所以沒寫，讓腳印第一次在 03 出現。

EP1-07-02.zh: 鏡頭站在泥岸上靠近水邊的地方，沿著河岸拍過去，河在右手邊、森林在左手邊。畫面右邊是河：水邊就在很近的地方，再過去是很寬的河面，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林。畫面左邊是平坦、光禿禿的泥地，再過去是茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。夾在河和森林中間的泥岸一直往遠處延伸。上午的陽光從鏡頭左後方照過來。森林邊那棵大樹在鏡頭左後方，看不到。
EP1-07-02.en: Background: The camera stands on the mud bank close to the water's edge and looks along the riverbank, with the river on the right and the forest on the left. On the right side of the picture is the river: the water's edge is very close, then a wide, slow river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest. On the left side of the picture is flat bare mud, and beyond it the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. The strip of mud between the river and the forest stretches far into the distance. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the left. The huge tree at the forest edge is behind the camera on the left and is not in the picture.

EP1-07-03.zh: 鏡頭在森林邊上高高地往下拍，背對森林、對著河的方向。畫面裡大部分是平坦、光禿禿的泥地。HERO 腳邊、靠鏡頭這一側的泥地上，有一個很大的三趾腳印，大小正好是成年暴龍自己的腳，腳印裡只積了一點雨水。泥地往上延伸到水邊，畫面上緣是一條河面。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。茂密的森林在鏡頭後面，看不到。
EP1-07-03.en: Background: The camera is high up at the edge of the forest, looking down, with its back to the trees and facing toward the river. Most of the picture is flat, bare mud. In the mud right by HERO's feet, on the side toward the camera, is a huge three-toed footprint pressed into the mud, exactly the size of an adult T. rex's own foot, with only a little rainwater inside it. The mud runs up to the water's edge, and along the top of the picture is a strip of the river. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The dense forest is behind the camera and is not in the picture.

EP1-07-04.zh: 從上面往下近拍，畫面裡只有腳印邊緣的一小塊泥地：濕軟的泥巴邊，低的地方積著一點水，水正從泥邊慢慢滲出來。上午的陽光斜斜照在濕泥上，積水有一點反光。
EP1-07-04.en: Background: Seen from above, very close. Only a small patch of mud at the edge of the footprint is in the picture: a soft, wet rim of mud, a little water pooled in the low part, and water slowly seeping out of the mud at the edge. Morning sunlight falls at a slant across the wet mud, with a small glint on the water.

EP1-07-05.zh: 鏡頭在河邊的水面上方高處，背對河，往下對著岸上和森林拍。畫面下緣露出一點河水的邊。往上是一大片平坦、光禿禿、空蕩蕩的泥地，只有 HERO 腳邊那一個很大的三趾腳印，大小正好是成年暴龍自己的腳，腳印裡只積了一點雨水；泥地上沒有別的腳印。HERO 右邊再遠一點的泥地上有一叢蕨類，蕨類叢邊上長著一棵細細的小樹。畫面上緣是茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。上午的陽光從畫面左邊照過來。森林邊那棵大樹在畫面左邊外面，看不到。
EP1-07-05.en: Background: The camera is high above the water at the river's edge, with its back to the river, looking down at the bank and the forest. A thin strip of river water shows along the bottom edge of the picture. Above it is a wide, flat, empty stretch of bare mud. The only mark in it is one huge three-toed footprint right by HERO's feet, exactly the size of an adult T. rex's own foot, with only a little rainwater inside it; there are no other footprints anywhere. A little farther away, to HERO's right, is a clump of ferns with a thin young tree growing at its edge. Along the top of the picture is the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. Morning sunlight comes from the left side of the picture. The huge tree at the forest edge is just outside the picture on the left.

EP1-07-06.zh: 鏡頭站在森林邊上，背對森林，對著河。畫面下緣露出一點這一岸的泥地，再過去是很寬、流得很慢的河，橫過整個畫面。河對岸是一條平平的泥灘，泥灘後面是開闊、朦朧的森林，顏色很淡，樹和樹之間有空隙。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來，照亮對岸。茂密的森林和那棵大樹在鏡頭後面，畫面裡看不到。
EP1-07-06.en: Background: The camera stands at the edge of the forest with its back to the trees, facing the river. A little of the mud on this side shows along the bottom edge of the picture, and beyond it a wide, slow river crosses the whole picture. On the far bank is a strip of flat muddy riverside ground, and behind it a distant, open, hazy forest, soft and pale, with gaps between the trees. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right and lights up the far bank. The dense forest and the huge tree are behind the camera and are not in the picture.
EP1-07-06.conflict: 照走位 t=3 HERO 在 L18，正好在相機和鴨嘴龍之間、離鏡頭很近，但 cast 沒有 HERO。描述裡沒寫他，請確認這格要不要讓 HERO 入鏡。

EP1-07-07.zh: 鏡頭在水邊，背對河，對著岸上和森林。HERO 背後是平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，再過去是一整排茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，橫過整個畫面。畫面左邊，森林邊上有一棵比其他樹都高大很多的樹。上午的陽光從畫面左前方照過來，有一點逆光。河在鏡頭後面，看不到。
EP1-07-07.en: Background: The camera is at the water's edge with its back to the river, facing the bank and the forest. Behind HERO is a flat stretch of bare mud, and beyond it the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, running across the whole picture. On the left side of the picture, at the forest edge, stands one huge tree that is much bigger than the rest. Morning sunlight comes from the front left of the picture, slightly against the camera. The river is behind the camera and is not in the picture.

EP1-07-08.zh: 鏡頭在泥岸上，沿著河岸斜斜地對著森林邊的那棵大樹拍。畫面右邊是茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹；森林邊上那棵比其他樹都高大很多的樹在畫面右邊。畫面左邊是平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，一直往遠處延伸，最左邊遠處露出一點河面。HERO 和大樹之間隔著一大片空的泥地。上午的太陽在畫面前方、大樹那一邊的天上，逆光。河大部分在鏡頭左後方，蕨類叢和細樹在畫面右邊外面，都看不到。
EP1-07-08.en: Background: The camera is on the mud bank, looking at an angle along the riverbank toward the huge tree at the forest edge. On the right side of the picture is the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, and at that edge, on the right side of the picture, stands one huge tree much bigger than the rest. On the left side of the picture, flat bare mud stretches far into the distance, and at the far left a little of the river shows in the distance. Between HERO and the huge tree is a wide, empty stretch of mud. The morning sun is in the sky ahead, above the huge tree, so the picture is backlit. Most of the river is behind the camera on the left, and the clump of ferns and the thin tree are just outside the picture on the right.

EP1-07-08W.zh: 鏡頭站在水邊，沿著河岸斜斜地對著森林邊的那棵大樹拍，看得比較遠。畫面最左邊沿著岸邊是一條河水，往遠處延伸。畫面中間是一大片平坦、光禿禿、空蕩蕩的泥岸。畫面右邊是茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹；森林邊上那棵比其他樹都高大很多的樹在畫面右邊，離鏡頭很遠。上午的太陽在畫面前方、大樹那一邊的天上，逆光。河大部分在鏡頭左後方，蕨類叢和細樹在畫面右邊外面，都看不到。
EP1-07-08W.en: Background: The camera stands at the water's edge, looking at an angle along the riverbank toward the huge tree at the forest edge, and sees a long way. Along the far left edge of the picture runs a strip of river water beside the bank, stretching into the distance. Across the middle of the picture is a wide, flat, empty stretch of bare mud. On the right side of the picture is the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, and at that edge, on the right side of the picture and far from the camera, stands one huge tree much bigger than the rest. The morning sun is in the sky ahead, above the huge tree, so the picture is backlit. Most of the river is behind the camera on the left, and the clump of ferns and the thin tree are just outside the picture on the right.

EP1-07-09.zh: 鏡頭在森林邊上貼著地面，背對森林、對著河的方向往上仰拍。地平線壓得很低：近處是平坦的泥地，再過去是很寬的河，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林。地平線以上大半是天空。畫面左邊邊上露出幾片近處的枝葉。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。茂密的森林和那棵大樹在鏡頭後面，看不到。
EP1-07-09.en: Background: The camera is down at ground level at the edge of the forest, with its back to the trees, looking up and out toward the river. The horizon sits very low: close by is flat mud, then a wide river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest. Above the horizon, most of the picture is sky. A few nearby leaves poke in along the left edge of the picture. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The dense forest and the huge tree are behind the camera and are not in the picture.
EP1-07-09.conflict: 照走位對岸 L4 的鴨嘴龍群會在畫面裡，但 cast 沒有牠們、prompt 寫只有兩個角色；依規則描述裡不寫角色，請決定要不要入鏡。

EP1-07-09W.zh: 鏡頭在森林裡面貼著地面，從樹縫往外仰拍，對著河的方向。畫面左右兩邊是近處的粗樹幹和蘇鐵、針葉樹的枝葉，像框一樣圍住畫面。中間望出去是平坦的泥岸，再過去是很寬的河，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林；地平線壓得很低，上面是大片天空。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。那棵大樹在畫面右邊外面的森林裡，看不到。
EP1-07-09W.en: Background: The camera is down at ground level inside the forest, looking up and out through a gap in the trees toward the river. On both sides of the picture are nearby thick tree trunks and cycad and conifer leaves, framing the view. Through the gap is flat mud, then a wide river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest; the horizon sits very low, with a big sky above it. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The huge tree is in the forest just outside the picture on the right.
EP1-07-09W.conflict: 相機 L24 在茂密森林裡第 4 排，往外拍會被樹擋住；照地圖寫成從樹縫往外拍、兩邊有樹幹枝葉。若要乾淨畫面，相機應移到森林邊緣 L21。另外對岸 L4 的鴨嘴龍群在畫面裡但不在 cast，沒寫。

EP1-07-10.zh: 手機螢幕幾乎塞滿整個畫面。手機後面的邊緣只露出一點模糊的森林綠色和泥地。上午的陽光從畫面左邊照過來。
EP1-07-10.en: Background: The phone screen fills almost the whole picture. Around the edges behind the phone, only a little blurred green of the forest and some mud show. Morning sunlight comes from the left side of the picture.

EP1-07-11.zh: 鏡頭在森林邊上，背對森林、對著河的方向。畫面中間偏左是一叢蕨類，蕨類叢靠左的後邊長著一棵細細的小樹。蕨類四周是平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，再過去是很寬、流得很慢的河，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林。畫面邊上露出幾片近處的枝葉。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。那棵大樹在鏡頭右後方，看不到。
EP1-07-11.en: Background: The camera is at the edge of the forest, with its back to the trees, facing toward the river. Just left of the middle of the picture is a clump of ferns, with a thin young tree growing at its back left corner. Around the ferns is flat bare mud, then a wide, slow river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest. A few nearby leaves poke in along the edges of the picture. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The huge tree is behind the camera on the right and is not in the picture.
EP1-07-11.conflict: 照走位對岸 L4 的鴨嘴龍群會在畫面裡，但 cast 沒有牠們；依規則描述裡不寫角色，請決定要不要入鏡。

EP1-07-11W.zh: 鏡頭在森林裡面，從樹縫往外對著河的方向拍。畫面左右兩邊是近處的樹幹和蘇鐵、針葉樹的枝葉，像框一樣圍住畫面。中間望出去，近一點是一叢蕨類，蕨類叢靠左的後邊長著一棵細細的小樹；蕨類四周是平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，再過去是很寬、流得很慢的河，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。那棵大樹在畫面右邊外面的森林裡，看不到。
EP1-07-11W.en: Background: The camera is inside the forest, looking out through a gap in the trees toward the river. On both sides of the picture are nearby tree trunks and cycad and conifer leaves, framing the view. Through the gap, closer in, is a clump of ferns with a thin young tree growing at its back left corner; around the ferns is flat bare mud, then a wide, slow river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The huge tree is in the forest just outside the picture on the right.
EP1-07-11W.conflict: 相機 K24 在茂密森林裡第 4 排，往外拍會被樹擋住；照地圖寫成從樹縫往外拍、兩邊有樹幹枝葉。若要乾淨畫面，相機應移到森林邊緣 K21。另外對岸 L4 的鴨嘴龍群在畫面裡但不在 cast，沒寫。

EP1-07-12.zh: 鏡頭在森林邊上，背對森林、對著泥岸和河。暴龍口鼻的後面是平坦的泥岸，再過去是很寬的河，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林。畫面左邊很近的地方是一叢蕨類。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。茂密的森林在鏡頭後面，看不到。
EP1-07-12.en: Background: The camera is at the edge of the forest, with its back to the trees, facing the mud bank and the river. Behind the T. rex's snout is flat mud, then a wide river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest. Very close on the left side of the picture is a clump of ferns. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The dense forest is behind the camera and is not in the picture.
EP1-07-12.conflict: 地圖小圖把鏡頭對準暴龍身體 N20（斜著沿河岸拍），那樣蕨類會在鏡頭後面；但構圖要蕨類在畫面左邊、鼻子湊在蕨類旁，所以照鼻子實際的位置（蕨類旁、K19 一帶）寫成鏡頭對著河。對岸 L4 的鴨嘴龍群可能入鏡但不在 cast，沒寫。

EP1-07-12W.zh: 鏡頭在森林邊上，背對森林、對著泥岸和河，比上一格退後一點。暴龍頭的後面是平坦的泥岸，再過去是很寬的河，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林。畫面左下是一叢蕨類。畫面邊上露出幾片近處的枝葉。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。茂密的森林在鏡頭後面，看不到。
EP1-07-12W.en: Background: The camera is at the edge of the forest, with its back to the trees, facing the mud bank and the river, a little farther back than the previous shot. Behind the T. rex's head is flat mud, then a wide river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest. In the lower left of the picture is a clump of ferns. A few nearby leaves poke in along the edges of the picture. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The dense forest is behind the camera and is not in the picture.
EP1-07-12W.conflict: 同 12：地圖小圖對準暴龍身體 N20，蕨類會在鏡頭後面；照構圖和鼻子實際位置寫成鏡頭對著河。對岸 L4 的鴨嘴龍群可能入鏡但不在 cast，沒寫。

EP1-07-13.zh: 畫面被暴龍的一隻眼睛和眼睛周圍的鱗片塞滿，看不到任何景物。上午的陽光從上方斜斜照在鱗片上。
EP1-07-13.en: Background: The T. rex's eye and the scales around it fill the whole picture; no scenery shows. Morning sunlight falls at a slant across the scales from above.

EP1-07-14.zh: 鏡頭貼著地面，背對河，斜斜地對著森林往上仰拍那棵細細的小樹。細樹的根部長在一叢蕨類的邊上，蕨類在畫面左下。樹幹往上伸進天空；樹的後面是茂密的森林邊緣，蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹的樹梢襯著天空。上午的陽光從畫面左邊照過來。河在鏡頭後面，看不到。
EP1-07-14.en: Background: The camera is down at ground level with its back to the river, looking up at an angle toward the forest at the thin young tree. The base of the thin tree grows at the edge of a clump of ferns, which sits in the lower left of the picture. The trunk reaches up into the sky; behind the tree is the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest, the tops of its cycads, ginkgos and conifers standing against the sky. Morning sunlight comes from the left side of the picture. The river is behind the camera and is not in the picture.
EP1-07-14.conflict: 走位 t=8 HERO 在 H19 爬樹，但地圖上細樹在 I19（蕨類叢的角上）；照地圖把細樹寫在蕨類叢邊上。

EP1-07-15.zh: 鏡頭在森林邊上，背對森林、對著河。畫面下方偏右、很近的地方是一叢蕨類，那棵細樹就從蕨類叢靠左的地方長出來。再過去是平坦的泥岸，然後是很寬、流得很慢的河，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林。畫面邊上露出幾片近處的枝葉。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。那棵大樹在鏡頭右後方，看不到。
EP1-07-15.en: Background: The camera is at the edge of the forest, with its back to the trees, facing the river. Very close, in the lower right of the picture, is a clump of ferns, and the thin tree grows out of the left part of that clump. Beyond it is flat bare mud, then a wide, slow river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest. A few nearby leaves poke in along the edges of the picture. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The huge tree is behind the camera on the right and is not in the picture.
EP1-07-15.conflict: 照走位對岸 L4 的鴨嘴龍群會在畫面裡，但 cast 沒有牠們；依規則描述裡不寫角色，請決定要不要入鏡。

EP1-07-15W.zh: 鏡頭在森林裡面，從樹縫往外對著河拍。畫面左右兩邊是近處的樹幹和蘇鐵、針葉樹的枝葉，像框一樣圍住畫面。中間望出去，近一點是一叢蕨類，那棵細樹從蕨類叢靠左的地方長出來；再過去是平坦的泥岸，然後是很寬、流得很慢的河，河對岸是一條泥灘和朦朧、顏色很淡的森林。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。那棵大樹在畫面右邊外面的森林裡，看不到。
EP1-07-15W.en: Background: The camera is inside the forest, looking out through a gap in the trees toward the river. On both sides of the picture are nearby tree trunks and cycad and conifer leaves, framing the view. Through the gap, closer in, is a clump of ferns, with the thin tree growing out of the left part of it; beyond it is flat bare mud, then a wide, slow river, and on the far bank a strip of muddy ground and a distant, hazy, pale forest. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right. The huge tree is in the forest just outside the picture on the right.
EP1-07-15W.conflict: 相機 I24 在茂密森林裡第 4 排，往外拍會被樹擋住；照地圖寫成從樹縫往外拍、兩邊有樹幹枝葉。若要乾淨畫面，相機應移到森林邊緣 I21。另外對岸 L4 的鴨嘴龍群在畫面裡但不在 cast，沒寫。

EP1-07-16.zh: （閃回，不在河岸。）從斜上方往下拍博士實驗室裡那張電子工作桌的桌面。畫面裡大部分是空的桌面；邊緣露出一角電路板和一支烙鐵。早上的陽光從工作桌上方、靠牆那邊的小窗照進來，落在桌面上。
EP1-07-16.en: Background: (A flashback, not at the river.) Seen from above at an angle, looking down at the top of the electronics workbench in the professor's lab. Most of the picture is bare work surface; a corner of a circuit board and a soldering iron just show at the edges. Morning sunlight comes in through the small window on the wall above the workbench and falls across the work surface.
EP1-07-16.conflict: 這格是實驗室閃回，跟河岸地圖無關（分鏡相機 L19 是河岸格子）；改照 lab.json 的電子工作桌（上方有窗，放求生小冊子和水壺）寫。

EP1-07-17.zh: 鏡頭在泥岸上往上仰拍，背對河，斜斜地對著森林邊緣。暴龍頭的後面是茂密森林高高的樹梢，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，再上面是天空；偏左遠處，森林邊上那棵大樹的樹冠比其他樹都高。上午的太陽在畫面前方偏右的天上，有點逆光。河在鏡頭左後方，看不到。
EP1-07-17.en: Background: The camera is on the mud bank looking up, with its back to the river, facing the forest edge at an angle. Behind the T. rex's head are the tall treetops of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, and above them the sky; a little to the left and far away, the crown of the huge tree at the forest edge rises above all the other trees. The morning sun is in the sky ahead and slightly to the right, so the picture is a little backlit. The river is behind the camera on the left and is not in the picture.

EP1-07-17W.zh: 鏡頭在泥岸上往上仰拍，背對河，斜斜地對著森林邊緣，比上一格退後一點。畫面下方是平坦的泥地，暴龍腳邊有一叢蕨類。再過去是茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，樹梢上面是天空；森林邊上那棵比其他樹都高大很多的樹在畫面中間遠處。上午的太陽在畫面前方偏右的天上，有點逆光。河在鏡頭左後方，看不到。
EP1-07-17W.en: Background: The camera is on the mud bank looking up, with its back to the river, facing the forest edge at an angle, a little farther back than the previous shot. Along the bottom of the picture is flat mud, with a clump of ferns by the T. rex's feet. Beyond is the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, with sky above the treetops; far away in the middle of the picture, the huge tree at the forest edge stands much taller than the rest. The morning sun is in the sky ahead and slightly to the right, so the picture is a little backlit. The river is behind the camera on the left and is not in the picture.

EP1-07-18.zh: 鏡頭在泥岸上靠森林的那一邊，沿著河岸拍過去，森林在右手邊、河在左手邊。畫面右邊緊挨著茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，一路往遠處延伸；遠處森林邊上那棵比其他樹都高大很多的樹在畫面中間偏右。畫面左邊是平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，再過去是很寬的河。畫面中間的泥地上有一叢蕨類，蕨類叢左邊長著一棵細細的小樹。上午的陽光從畫面右前方照過來。鏡頭後面，泥岸和河繼續往另一頭延伸，看不到。
EP1-07-18.en: Background: The camera is on the forest side of the mud bank, looking along the riverbank, with the forest on the right and the river on the left. Right alongside on the right side of the picture is the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, running off into the distance; far away at that edge, a little right of the middle of the picture, stands one huge tree much bigger than the rest. On the left side of the picture is flat bare mud, and beyond it a wide river. On the mud in the middle of the picture is a clump of ferns, with a thin young tree growing on its left. Morning sunlight comes from the front right of the picture. Behind the camera, the bank and the river continue the other way and are not in the picture.

EP1-07-18W.zh: 鏡頭站在森林邊上，沿著河岸拍過去，比上一格退後一點。畫面右邊緊挨著鏡頭就是茂密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，森林邊緣一路往遠處延伸；遠處森林邊上那棵比其他樹都高大很多的樹在畫面右邊。畫面左邊是平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，再過去是很寬的河。畫面中間的泥地上有一叢蕨類，蕨類叢左邊長著一棵細細的小樹。上午的陽光從畫面右前方照過來。鏡頭後面，泥岸和河繼續往另一頭延伸，看不到。
EP1-07-18W.en: Background: The camera stands at the edge of the forest, looking along the riverbank, a little farther back than the previous shot. On the right side of the picture, right next to the camera, is a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, its edge running off into the distance; far away at that edge, on the right side of the picture, stands one huge tree much bigger than the rest. On the left side of the picture is flat bare mud, and beyond it a wide river. On the mud in the middle of the picture is a clump of ferns, with a thin young tree growing on its left. Morning sunlight comes from the front right of the picture. Behind the camera, the bank and the river continue the other way and are not in the picture.

EP1-07-19.zh: 鏡頭在泥岸上，沿著河岸拍過去，河在左手邊、森林在右手邊。畫面左邊是很寬的河，沿著岸邊往遠處延伸。畫面中間是平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，一路延伸到遠處。畫面右邊是茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹；靠右的泥地上有一叢蕨類，旁邊長著一棵細細的小樹。遠處森林邊上那棵比其他樹都高大很多的樹在畫面中間偏右。上午的陽光從畫面右前方照過來，有點逆光。鏡頭後面，泥岸和河繼續往另一頭延伸，看不到。
EP1-07-19.en: Background: The camera is on the mud bank looking along the riverbank, with the river on the left and the forest on the right. On the left side of the picture is a wide river, running along the bank into the distance. Through the middle of the picture, flat bare mud stretches far into the distance. On the right side of the picture is the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers; on the mud toward the right is a clump of ferns with a thin young tree beside it. Far away at the forest edge, a little right of the middle of the picture, stands one huge tree much bigger than the rest. Morning sunlight comes from the front right of the picture, a little against the camera. Behind the camera, the bank and the river continue the other way and are not in the picture.

EP1-07-19W.zh: 鏡頭站在泥岸上靠水邊的地方，沿著河岸拍過去，比上一格退後一點。畫面左邊緊挨著就是河，很寬，沿著岸邊往遠處延伸。畫面中間是一大片平坦、光禿禿的泥岸，一路延伸到遠處。畫面右邊是茂密的森林邊緣，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹；靠右的泥地上有一叢蕨類，旁邊長著一棵細細的小樹。遠處森林邊上那棵比其他樹都高大很多的樹在畫面中間偏右。上午的陽光從畫面右前方照過來，有點逆光。鏡頭後面，泥岸和河繼續往另一頭延伸，看不到。
EP1-07-19W.en: Background: The camera stands on the mud bank near the water's edge, looking along the riverbank, a little farther back than the previous shot. Right alongside on the left side of the picture is the wide river, running along the bank into the distance. Through the middle of the picture, a wide stretch of flat bare mud runs far into the distance. On the right side of the picture is the edge of a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers; on the mud toward the right is a clump of ferns with a thin young tree beside it. Far away at the forest edge, a little right of the middle of the picture, stands one huge tree much bigger than the rest. Morning sunlight comes from the front right of the picture, a little against the camera. Behind the camera, the bank and the river continue the other way and are not in the picture.
